hero.eyebrow: IT PROFESSIONAL · TECHNOLOGY MENTOR · WEB DEVELOPMENT
hero.subtitle: With 30+ years of experience in IT, I turn complex technology into practical, easy-to-understand learning — helping people build skills in web development, networking, systems, and modern digital tools.

paragraphs: Senior ICT professional with more than 33 years of experience in office and program management, MIS, ICT operations, network infrastructure, security, and computer/network troubleshooting.

Currently serving as Deputy Director — ICT at RTM International, with responsibility for the organization's overall network and ICT systems across the head office, branch/field offices, RTMI-HRDC and RTM Al-Kabir Technical University (RTM-AKTU).
Experienced in ICT planning, communication systems, digital security, team supervision, technical support, and technology-related administrative planning.
